threads.body: This change to `testShutdownCommandProducesNoSpan` is unrelated to the PR's stated scope (Redis batch/pipeline current-behavior tests) and isn't covered by any of the test selectors in the validation section of the PR description. It also weakens the assertion: previously the `error` attribute was expected to be `"Connection disconnected"` for old-semconv non-latest-deps runs, and now it is asserted to always be `null`. Please confirm this matches current `main` behavior for all run modes (old/stable semconv × latest/non-latest deps) and that this test was actually exercised, since `*testShutdownCommand*` is not in the listed validation runs.

threads.body: The `aggregateDeferredFlush()` hook always returns `false` and is not overridden by any subclass in the repository, so this entire aggregation branch — together with the `pipelineOperation(...)` and `pipelineStatement(...)` helpers it is the sole caller of — is currently unreachable dead code. Since this PR is meant to pin the current per-command behavior, consider removing this branch (and the two helpers) for now, or, if a library variant is expected to aggregate deferred flushes into a single PIPELINE span, add the override that exercises it so the assertions are actually covered.
